content: The individuals involved in the technical presentations and related discussions provided factual information, feedback, and clarifications when necessary. However, they did not participate in or influence the recommendations made. Ms. Monica Guamuch, Laboratorio de Composición de Alimentos, Instituto de Nutrición de Centro América y Panamá, Guatemala City, Guatemala. Dr. Becky Tsang, Food Fortification Initiative, Atlanta, United States of America. Dr. Rizwan Yusufali, United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund, New York, NY, United States of America.
